==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Using the self induced sleep paralysis method, I attain lucidity. I test my combat skills against a glowing red superhuman.
Both of us warp reality as we battle. My opponent pushes me into a black hole.
I fast forward through time to the end of the universe. Luckily time is cyclical and a new universe forms.
